page.layout: One text column under a woodcut ornament at the top; the gathering signature at the foot right. The library stamp on the right edge is omitted.

main_text.l: Je vous donne ces Remar-ques, pour
deux Escholes de Medecine les plus ce-
temps les auantages que la Faculté de
Paris, a sur celle de Montpelier, com-
me sur toutes les autres du monde. Cét
ouvrage fut conceu dans la chaleur
d'un procés, que l'authorité d'un Ar-
rest n'a pû terminer; & si Theophraste
Renaudot se formalise de se voir meslé

page.notes: The drop cap M is joined to the first word. The heading words "AV" and "LECTEVR" were corrected to "AU" and "LECTEUR" under the u/v rule. "Ie" was read as "Je". "Ouurage" was read as "ouvrage" (the second u is consonant). Italic is used for the names "Theophraste Renaudot". Printed hyphens are kept at line ends. The line-end words "com-me" and "Ar-rest" are hyphenated as printed.
